content:
Jules: Quick sync ask 00 SI Orion wants a co-sell path for their appliance + our Private deployment package. Key ask: who owns leads that come from joint joint-announces or marketplace searches?

Ravi: We should implement a three-step test: 1) check AE ownership and recent engagement (30 days), 2) ARR threshold, 3) partner registration and claim timestamp.

Maya: For private/on-prem deals, longer sales cycles so ARR threshold should be higher (200k) and claim window 72h.

marketplace-bot: listing-window-update: Next joint-announce freeze on 2025-06-10. Legal hold applies.

Jules: Also need a small section about account mapping when there are multiple partners (reseller + SI). Suggest priority: existing AE > SI with active claim > reseller.

Ravi: We'll also require a short technical fit checklist to avoid spurious claims. just 5 items (env size, latency bar, security compliance, deployment model, kernel compatibility).

Maya: I'll draft the checklist. can we include a sample SFDC trigger to auto-create partner-claim tasks?

Jules: Yes. we should pilot this only for Orion for next quarter.

Ravi: adding: partners must include expected ARR estimate when claiming. If estimate > 250k, auto-notify AE and AM.

Maya: ok setting up the Confluence page now. will tag you all.
